title: smallRNAseq-DREAM: a cross-species small RNA-seq framework and NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) plant RNA-seq dataset inventory
description: Code and documentation for a cross-species small RNA-seq (miRNA) analysis framework (four analysis engines and a synthetic ground-truth benchmarking harness), NASA OSDR retrieval tools, and an inventory of 12 NASA OSDR plant RNA-seq studies (Arabidopsis thaliana, Brachypodium distachyon, Solanum lycopersicum, Brassica rapa). OSDR holds no plant small RNA-seq; OSD-437 is standard poly(A) RNA-seq. The repository also contains an exploratory scan of GeneLab differential-expression tables for miRNA-related signal whose outputs are not interpretable yet: its locus map mislabels most IDs and its log2FC columns are not flight-vs-ground contrasts (see README, Status). The four-engine benchmark has not been run.
